data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that shows a customizable splash screen for Flame games.
data.what_it_does: Provides a ready‑to‑use splash screen widget for Flame projects. You can choose a dark or white theme, supply custom content before or after the Flame logo, and control animation timing via a controller.
use_when: You need a quick, themed splash screen for a Flame‑based game
You want to show a logo or custom widget before the game starts without writing animation code
avoid_when: You need a full‑screen app launch splash that runs before Flutter initializes
You require complex multi‑step onboarding or non‑Flame specific splash screens
strengths: Very easy to integrate – just add the dependency and use the widget
Supports custom content and animation timing through a controller
Matches Flame’s visual style out of the box
weaknesses: Only useful for Flame games, not a general purpose splash solution
Customization limited to provided theme and simple builder callbacks
